title: Suspected fracture / splinting

source.name: MedlinePlus: Broken bone — U.S. National Library of Medicine

steps: Check breathing and control any serious bleeding first.
Keep the injured part still. Do not try to straighten it.
Cover any open wound with a clean dressing.
Check feeling, color and pulse below the injury.
Splint the limb in the position found, including the joints above and below the injury.
Pad the splint and secure it without cutting off circulation.
Recheck feeling, color and pulse below the splint.
Apply a cold pack wrapped in cloth to reduce swelling.
callForHelp: Limb is cold, blue or numb below the injury
Suspected head, neck, back, hip or thigh injury
